packages.label: תְּשׁוּבָה וּבִטּוּל הַזְּמַן
packages.reason: All these concepts share the same essential nature: the transcendence of the bounded, finite dimension of time. Teshuvah is explicitly stated to BE bitul hazmanim — they are bechina achat (one aspect). From this same cluster: the 22 letters of Torah (aleph-beit) = stones = speech-acts = teshuvah, because 'take with you words and return'; the shortening of the sun (niskatzar hazman) = bitul hazman; the unification of time (hitachdut hazman) = teshuvah = love (Avraham's quality); the formula Yitzchak-ben-Avraham encodes the complete structure (time + teshuvah + above-time). Kriat Yam Suf and Milchemet Amalek are both bechina of bitul hazmanim and teshuvah. All nodes share the nature of breaking/transcending time's boundaries through return to God.

merge_notes.reason: This 4-node component (raw Component B) is semantically inseparable from the teshuvah/bitul-hazman core. Avraham = above time (his attribute is love, and love = unity of time per 'in his eyes as a few days in his love'). 'למעלה מן הזמן' is the same concept as 'למעלה מהזמן' in Component A, just a slight variant spelling in the node_id. Ahavah = hitachdut hazman. These are all alternative names for the transcendence-of-time domain already occupied by teshuvah.

This isolated pair represents the Rebbe's key formula: 'Yitzchak ben Avraham' = time (Yitzchak) unified (ben = teshuvah) into above-time (Avraham). Both nodes are direct expressions of the central thesis — teshuvah = bitul hazman — and belong in the teshuvah cluster. The proof text explicitly states: 'Yitzchak ben Avraham alludes to the unity of time through teshuvah.'

These two nodes form a bechina pair: 'the shortening of time' = 'the nullification of time.' The proof text explains that when the sun set early for Jacob, 'the time was shortened, which is the bechina of bitul hazman.' This is the same concept as 'בטול הזמנים' in the main component, making this pair a natural merge into Package 1.

packages.label: הַזְּמַן — יִצְחָק, קֵץ, שֵׁנָה, אַחֲרִית הַיָּמִים
packages.label_en: Time — Yitzhak, End, Sleep, End of Days
packages.reason: These five nodes are all expressions of time as the finite, bounded structural dimension of reality. Yitzhak (יצחק) = the letters Keitz Chai = the personification of time in the patriarchal world. Ketz (קץ) = the end, which is the bechina of time as 'acharit hayamim' (End of Days). Sheinah (שנה/sleep) = the primary mode in which time is experienced (as cited: 'the essence of time is in the aspect of sleep'). These are not expressions of holiness or evil — they are structural/ontological faces of the temporal dimension itself. Time is what teshuvah transcends. This package represents the raw material that Package 1 works upon.

packages.label: קוֹל דִּקְדֻשָּׁה
packages.reason: These two nodes are bechina of each other: 'His blessed voice' (קולו יתברך) and 'the voice of holiness' (קול דקדשה) are two names for the same divine reality — the sacred call that one merits to hear through teshuvah and bitul hazmanim. The Torah's core verse is 'וְשַׁבְתָּ עַד ה' אֱלֹקֶיךָ וְשָׁמַעְתָּ בְּקוֹלוֹ' — return to God and hear His voice. Hearing this voice is the culminating attainment of the entire teaching. This package is small but thematically distinct: it is the telos/destination, while Package 1 is the path. The evil mirror of this package is the 'kol d'sitra achra' — the voice of Esav — which tries to drown out the holy voice (discussed extensively in the source text but not represented as a bechina node in the dataset).
